description: Declares the common layer contract: which agents and skills are provided by templates/common/, their versions, and override governance rules. Variants inherit these via new-project.ts and may declare overrides in their variant.json. Country-scoped skills (k-law/k-dart/k-kosis, tracked in workspace-schema.json country_scoped_assets) and variant-scoped skills (tracked in variant_scoped_skills, living in templates/co-*/skills/) are deliberately out of this contract.

governance.anti_swelling_note: If >= 50% of variants override the same agent, the common definition should be updated instead

override_types.additive: Variant adds sections to common content. Auto-approved. Scaffolding: concatenate common + partial.
override_types.replacement: Variant modifies common content. Requires lifecycle-manager review. Scaffolding: variant file replaces common.

pm.description: Project Manager — orchestrates phases 0, 1-2, 5; universal across all variants

common_scripts.description: Scripts shared across L0, L1, and L2 layers. Source of truth: scripts/SCRIPTS.md Layer column. Scripts with Layer='L0+L1' are in templates/common/scripts/ but not in L2. Scripts with Layer='L0+L1+L2' are copied to all layers during scaffolding.

layer_values.L0: Workspace root only — not propagated to L1 or L2
layer_values.L0+L1: Propagated to templates/common/scripts/ — not in L2 projects
layer_values.L0+L1+L2: Propagated to all layers including L2 projects

platform_settings.description: Classifies .claude/settings.json and .gemini/settings.json keys into tiers. SSOT for platform settings parity governance. Tier definitions: shared=required in both, claude_only=Claude Code exclusive (absent from .gemini is correct), gemini_only=Gemini CLI exclusive (absent from .claude is correct). Note: Antigravity (VS Code extension) shares .gemini/settings.json but does NOT fire hooks.

shared.description: Settings that both Claude Code and Antigravity support with the same intent. Must be present in both .claude/settings.json and .gemini/settings.json.

hooks.SessionStart.description: Session start hook — both platforms support SessionStart

claude_only.description: Settings exclusive to Claude Code. Gemini CLI does not support these. Absent from .gemini/settings.json is CORRECT behavior, not a parity violation.

permissions.description: Claude Code permission allowlist (allow/deny tool patterns)
permissions.reason_excluded: Antigravity uses a different permission model

env.description: Environment variables injected into Claude Code session
env.reason_excluded: Antigravity env injection uses different mechanism

teammateMode.reason_excluded: Agent Teams is Claude Code-only; Antigravity uses Agent Manager UI

hooks.TeammateIdle.description: Fires when a Claude Code Agent Teams teammate becomes idle
hooks.TeammateIdle.reason_excluded: TeammateIdle event does not exist in Antigravity

hooks.TaskCreated.description: Fires when an Agent Teams task is created
hooks.TaskCreated.reason_excluded: TaskCreated event does not exist in Antigravity

hooks.TaskCompleted.description: Fires when an Agent Teams task is marked complete
hooks.TaskCompleted.reason_excluded: TaskCompleted event does not exist in Antigravity

hooks.PreToolUse.description: Pre-tool-use hook — fires before Claude Code executes a tool. Supports permissionDecision (allow/deny/ask/defer) and updatedInput.
hooks.PreToolUse.reason_excluded: Gemini CLI uses BeforeTool event instead

hooks.PostToolUse.description: Post-tool-use hook — fires after Claude Code executes Write/Edit tools. Moved from shared to claude_only since Gemini CLI uses AfterTool.
hooks.PostToolUse.reason_excluded: Gemini CLI uses AfterTool event instead

hooks.PreCompact.description: Pre-compaction hook — fires before Claude Code compacts conversation context
hooks.PreCompact.reason_excluded: Gemini CLI uses PreCompress event instead

hooks.WorktreeCreate.description: Fires when a Claude Code git worktree is created
hooks.WorktreeCreate.reason_excluded: WorktreeCreate event does not exist in Gemini CLI

gemini_only.description: Settings exclusive to Gemini CLI / Antigravity. Claude Code does not support these. Absent from .claude/settings.json is CORRECT behavior, not a parity violation. Note: Antigravity (VS Code extension) shares .gemini/settings.json but does NOT fire hooks.

hooks.BeforeTool.description: Pre-tool-use hook — fires before Gemini CLI executes a tool. stdin(JSON) → stdout(JSON), exit 2 = block.
hooks.BeforeTool.reason_excluded: Claude Code uses PreToolUse event instead

hooks.AfterTool.description: Post-tool-use hook — fires after Gemini CLI executes a tool. stdin(JSON) → stdout(JSON).
hooks.AfterTool.reason_excluded: Claude Code uses PostToolUse event instead

hooks.PreCompress.description: Pre-compression hook — fires before Gemini CLI compresses conversation context
hooks.PreCompress.reason_excluded: Claude Code uses PreCompact event instead
